outcome: temporal latency between first vaginal birth and presentation for prolapse surgery
cohort: The study included 85 women with levator ani muscle avulsion and significant prolapse who presented for evaluation prior to prolapse surgery in a tertiary urogynecological unit.
finding: The average latency between a first vaginal birth and presentation for prolapse surgery in women with levator avulsion was 33.5 years (range 3-66.3 years).
mod_finding: Forceps delivery showed a trend toward shorter latency to prolapse presentation.
followup_time: 33.5 years (average latency to presentation for surgery)
